text:
Haydock chases: what to look out for 🏇 A cheat sheet for Saturday's big chase day.

We went through 165 chases at Haydock since 2019. Favourites do best when it's soft: 21 won from 55. Winners at 20/1 or bigger are rare: just 2. And six-year-olds win about 1 in 4.

Save this before your next day at Haydock.

It's from the work behind our Haydock Track DNA guide, coming soon. Make finding a winner a little easier.

Which ground do you think is better at Haydock, and why? 👇

Data: Haydock chases, Jan 2019 to May 2026, ZANS results database.
